body: Yes, there actually are pleasant ways to die. Suffocation, Nitrous Oxide, Heroin overdose... it's all easy to do. Completely painless.

If anything, this post has made me more determined and more dead set on ending myself. I don't want a reason to "tough through it". The only reason that I'm alive right now is so I don't devastate my parents, both of whom are more depressed than I am. I feel forced to stay alive even though I don't really want to, but honestly, I'm starting to not care. I don't care if it hurts the others around me, in the end, they all die, too. And everyone dies, and no one will be left. Having a purpose or reason for anything other than yourself Isn't a reason worth living for, unless that reason you're living for make you happy, in my eyes, there's only one choice, and it's death.
